intro.en: How neighbours organise a building together: meetings, proposals, agreements and shared rules. With «para que» + subjunctive.

la comunidad de vecinos.nota: In Spain, the owners of a block of flats form una comunidad and share costs and decisions.

el presidente de la comunidad.en: the chair of the residents' association
el presidente de la comunidad.nota: Feminine: la presidenta. In many buildings the post rotates every year.

proponer.nota: Irregular like poner: propongo, propuse, propuesto.

ponerse de acuerdo.en: to agree, to reach an agreement

encargarse de.en: to take charge of, to be in charge of
encargarse de.nota: Me encargo de las llaves: I'll take care of the keys.

texto.en:
Most people in Spanish cities live in **pisos** (flats). The owners form **una comunidad de vecinos**, which pays shared costs with **una cuota** and meets once or twice a year in **una reunión de vecinos**.

At the meeting someone **propone** something, the neighbours discuss it, and if they cannot **ponerse de acuerdo**, they **votan**: **la mayoría** decides. The result is **un acuerdo**, and new **normas** are written down.

Useful ways to make a proposal: **Propongo que** + subjunctive, **¿Y si** + present?, **¿Qué os parece si** + present?

To agree or disagree politely: **Me parece bien**, **Estoy de acuerdo**, **No lo veo claro**, **Yo prefiero otra cosa**.

**Para** + infinitive expresses purpose when the subject is the same: **Pongo un cartel para avisar** (I put up a sign to let people know).

When the person who does the second action is different, use **para que** + subjunctive: **Pongo un cartel para que todos lo sepan** (I put up a sign so that everyone knows).

More examples: **Dejo las llaves para que el técnico pueda entrar.** **Hacemos turnos para que nadie trabaje más que los demás.**

frases.es: El jueves por la tarde los vecinos del número doce se reunieron en el portal.
frases.en: On Thursday afternoon the residents of number twelve met in the entrance hall.

frases.es: La presidenta propuso cambiar el ascensor, porque se estropea casi todos los meses.
frases.en: The chair proposed replacing the lift, because it breaks down almost every month.

frases.es: Algunos vecinos estaban de acuerdo, pero otros preferían esperar al año que viene.
frases.en: Some neighbours agreed, but others preferred to wait until next year.

frases.es: Al final votaron, y la mayoría aceptó pagar la obra en doce cuotas.
frases.en: In the end they voted, and the majority agreed to pay for the work in twelve instalments.

frases.es: También repartieron la limpieza de la escalera por turnos para que nadie trabaje más que los demás.
frases.en: They also shared out the cleaning of the stairs on a rota so that nobody works more than the others.

frases.es: Un voluntario se encargará de poner un cartel en el portal para que todos conozcan las nuevas normas.
frases.en: A volunteer will put up a sign in the entrance hall so that everyone knows the new rules.

pregunta.en: According to the text, what did the chair propose?

Replacing the lift.en: La presidenta propuso cambiar el ascensor.

Painting the entrance hall.en: The meeting took place in the entrance hall, but nobody proposed painting it.

Raising the cleaners' wages.en: The text says the neighbours will clean the stairs themselves, on a rota.

pregunta.en: How was the decision finally taken?

They voted and the majority decided.en: Al final votaron, y la mayoría aceptó.

The chair decided alone.en: She proposed it, but the neighbours voted.

They postponed it until next year.en: Some wanted to wait, but the majority accepted.

bloques.correcta: They voted and the majority decided

pregunta.en: Complete: I'm leaving the keys so that the technician can get in.

bloques.frase: Dejo las llaves para que el técnico ___ entrar.

puede.en: After «para que» you need the subjunctive, not the indicative.

poder.en: The infinitive is used with «para» only when the subject is the same.

pregunta.en: You want to suggest something at the meeting. Which sentence is correct?

Propongo que hacemos turnos..en: After «propongo que» the verb goes in the subjunctive.

texto.en: We didn't manage to put on our coats.

explicacion.en: «Ponerse de acuerdo» means to agree; it has nothing to do with clothes.
«Acordarse» is to remember; «ponerse de acuerdo» is to agree.

bloques.frase: La mayoría aceptó pagar la obra

traduccion.en: The majority agreed to pay for the work.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (100–120 words).** Your building needs a new rule (noise, pets, bicycles…). Write a short proposal for the residents' meeting using **propongo que** and **para que**.

**Speak (about 2 minutes).** Explain how people who share a home or a building organise themselves in your country.
